title: Vehicle handover experience and explanations
summary: This topic centers on handover experiences, with positive comments about memorable delivery and service alongside several unclear or incomplete remarks about understanding the car and missed explanations.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the handover as very good, memorable, and nicely presented as part of strong dealer service.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention not being able to absorb everything at handover, missing a follow-up walkthrough, and wanting better explanation of electronics, while one fragment is too incomplete to interpret confidently.

limitations: Most of the evidence is undetermined, so the balance of satisfaction versus dissatisfaction about handover explanations is unclear.
One undetermined fragment is incomplete and does not clearly indicate a view on the handover experience.
The sample is small and stratified, so it should not be treated as representative of all owners.
